svg.text: Codebase growth
One fifteen-verb ladder. What these record is what sets the version number, because the release
class is computed rather than typed.
/amplify-codebase-dtd [a path to walk, or blank for the current repository; --stage=alpha|beta|pre names a pre-release; --no-gate runs autonomously]
49 laws
DTD-native: walk a codebase through the layers it declares, expose what could be done as
measured gaps and reasoned ideas on the amplify band of the fifteen-verb ladder (tweak,
enrich, ameliorate, amplification and magnify), ask across five rounds of four which to
keep, write the study down as four documents, and name the release the kept ones amount
to without ever taking it
/enhance-codebase-dtd [a path to walk, or blank for the current repository; --stage=alpha|beta|pre names a pre-release; --no-gate runs autonomously]
49 laws
